description: Conectividad para el bienestar is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Organismo Promotor de Inversiones en Telecomunicaciones (PROMTEL). Información sobre el programa social federal "Conectividad para el Bienestar". Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Organismo Promotor de Inversiones en Telecomunicaciones (PROMTEL). Its tags are beneficiarios programas sociales, brecha digital, derecho información, desarrollo tecnológico, infraestructura información. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
